units.source_text: 不過，當我為了擺脫對人的恐懼，尋求可憐的一夜安眠，

en.t: However, when I sought one pitiful night of sleep in order to escape my fear of people,

units.source_text: 去妓院與那些我的「同類」妓女尋歡作樂時，

en.t: and went to brothels to amuse myself with those prostitutes who were my "own kind,"

units.source_text: 一種不自覺的令人厭惡的氣息開始飄蕩在我的身邊，

en.t: an unconscious and repulsive atmosphere began to drift around me,

units.source_text: 這完全是出乎我預料的「隨贈附錄」，

en.t: which was a completely unexpected "bonus appendix" I had never anticipated,

units.source_text: 可是，這個「附錄」漸漸鮮明地浮出表面，

en.t: but this "appendix" gradually rose to the surface with increasing clarity,

units.source_text: 被堀木一眼看穿時，我為之愕然，深感厭惡。

en.t: and when Horiki saw through it at a glance, I was stunned and felt a deep disgust.

units.source_text: 在旁人看來，通俗一點說，

en.t: Seen from the outside, to put it in plain terms,

units.source_text: 我是藉著妓女修煉自己，而且大有長進，

en.t: I was training myself through prostitutes, and I had made considerable progress,

units.source_text: 據說藉著妓女修煉與女人打交道的能力，

en.t: for it is said that training one's ability to deal with women through prostitutes

units.source_text: 是最為嚴苛且又是最富有成效的。

en.t: is the harshest method, and also the most effective.
